entities.summary: John Timothy McNicholas, O.P. was an Irish-born American Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Cincinnati from 1925 to 1950. He previously served as Bishop of Duluth from 1918 to 1925. McNicholas was a member of the Dominican Order.
